meta.notes: The squad's tutorial mission on the ground: the tunnel station of tut-sky, box for box, with the player on the road behind his own truck and a mission of one order and one word. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts tut-team

steps.line: Hold [Ctrl] and scroll to zoom out until you can see all four
They're throwing smoke so the roadblock can't see them move
Press [B] on the yard to move them in

after.line: They're using the smoke to get to the yard

steps.line: Go through the gate with them
Hold the gate with them. The enemies from the roadblock are coming
Press [B] on the door to stack them up

after.line: They're stacking up on the door

explain.title: Doors
explain.text:
The way into a room is usually its door. Point at a door and press [B] to stack the squad up beside it.
They'll wait there until you say go.

steps.line: Press [B] on the kitchen door, then [F]
Point at yourself and press [B] to call them to you

explain.title: Follow me
explain.text:
Point at yourself and press [B], and the squad will fall in behind you.
They'll follow you until you give them another order.

steps.line: Lead them across the yard to the last building
Press [B] on the last door, then [F]
Call them to you again and lead them back to the trucks
